objective: Measure local hybrid exploration using scheduled recipe/family regions, coverage feedback and novelty filtering. Compare random hypothesis filling with matched local reference generators at equal budgets.
query: 在给定的合成研究面板上，寻找对下月收益具有真实增量预测力的横截面因子假设。

dgp.seed_policy: Use paired development seeds across comparison arms. Evaluation seeds 3000+ remain reserved.

oracle.truth_definition: abs overall Spearman correlation between candidate values and the per-month-standardized injected mechanism signal std(F_ep * sign(F_illiq))
oracle.threshold_sensitivity: For a separate sensitivity analysis, recompute true-accept counts from saved candidate truth_loading values at thresholds 0.4 and 0.6; the runner classifies truth at the primary threshold 0.5.

glm.note: This protocol contains local generator arms only; no LLM API credentials are required.

interpretation.primary_metric: per-trial true-accept rate on alternative panels, with per-seed discovery counts (k/5) alongside
interpretation.decision_rule: CONFIRMED for a side only when its one-sided 95% Wilson lower bound exceeds the other side's upper bound; overlap reads INCONCLUSIVE; below minimum_pooled_trials reads INSUFFICIENT_DATA. Cross-protocol comparison against F3 uses the same paired seeds and is reported per-seed as well as pooled.
interpretation.reading_guide: Compare hybrid search with reference generators under matched inputs, seeds and budgets. Measure coverage and paired seed outcomes before attributing differences to search policy.
interpretation.clustering_caveat: Trials cluster within seeds; 5 independent alternative seeds per point. Statements about superiority require the paired per-seed view, not the pooled rate alone.
interpretation.null_rule: Null panels at b36 only; descriptive Wilson upper bound against the 0.1 target.

recipe_conformance_policy: The hybrid random generator declares the recipe its scheduled arm assigned and is conformant by construction; the harness verifies rather than trusts.
leakage_policy: The bandit reward is computed from gate feedback in the sanitized history only (agent/exploration.py gate_progress_reward takes failed_gates and decision, nothing else). Truth loading never enters the exploration policy; if it did, the synthetic result would not transfer to a real panel.
